en: I drew water from the well.
I didn't take money out of the pocket.
You (m.) pulled the chair toward you.
You (m.) didn't pull the rope well.
You (f.) brought up all the old talk.
You (f.) didn't take the key out of the bag.
He pulled the door gently.
He didn't pull the sick tooth.
She took the papers out of the cupboard.
She didn't pull the plank today.
We drew the bucket from the well.
We didn't bring up this topic.
You (pl.) pulled the thread quickly.
You (pl.) didn't pull the ball out from underneath.
They pulled the car with a rope.
They didn't draw water yesterday.
I always pull the plank carefully.
I do not bring up this talk.

lat: nta katjbed l-korsi dima l hna
en: You (m.) always pull the chair here.

lat: nta ma katjbedsh l-flus mn l-banka
ar: نتا ما كتجبدش الفلوس من البانكة
en: You (m.) do not withdraw money from the bank.
You (f.) are taking out the papers from the bag.

lat: nti ma katjebdish l-ma mn l-bir
ar: نتي ما كتجبديش الما من البير
en: You (f.) do not draw water from the well.
He takes out money every day.

lat: huwa ma kayjbedsh l-bab b qwa
en: He does not pull the door hard.
She pulls the bucket slowly.
She does not bring up this topic.
We draw water every morning.
We do not bring up old problems.
You (pl.) pull the rope every evening.

lat: ntuma ma katjebdush d-dwa mn temma
ar: نتوما ما كتجبدوش الدوا من تما
en: You (pl.) do not take medicine out of there.
They are pulling the car slowly.
They do not draw water now.

lat: daba ghadi njbed l-flus mn l-banka
ar: دابا غادي نجبد الفلوس من البانكة
en: Now I am going to withdraw money from the bank.

lat: ma ghadish njbed had l-hedra m3ahum
ar: ما غاديش نجبد هاد الهدرة معاهم
en: I am not going to bring up this topic with them.

lat: nta ghadi tjbed l-ktab mn s-sak
ar: نتا غادي تجبد الكتاب من الصاك
en: You (m.) are going to take the book out of the bag.

lat: ma ghadish tjbed l-bab b z-zerba
en: You (m.) are not going to pull the door quickly.

lat: nti ghadi tjebdi l-wraq mn d-dulab
ar: نتي غادي تجبدي الوراق من الدولاب
en: You (f.) are going to take the papers out of the cupboard.
You (f.) are not going to pull this ball out.
The doctor is going to pull the sick tooth.
He is not going to pull the chair.
The girl is going to pull the rope now.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tjbed l-flus l-yum
ar: هي ما غاديش تجبد الفلوس اليوم
en: She is not going to take out the money today.
We are going to draw water tomorrow.
We are not going to bring up problems.

lat: ntuma ghadi tjebdu l-7bel b qwa
en: You (pl.) are going to pull the rope hard.
You (pl.) are not going to pull the thread.

lat: huma ghadi yjebdu s-snadiq mn d-dar
ar: هما غادي يجبدو الصناديق من الدار
en: They are going to pull the boxes from the house.

lat: huma ma ghadish yjebdu had l-mowdu3
ar: هما ما غاديش يجبدو هاد الموضوع
en: They are not going to bring up this subject.
